english:
Disabled in the Crucible.

Not dealing or receiving damage for at least 9 seconds starts granting a stack of <stasis Frost Armor /> every 3 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Its duration continues to refresh every 3 seconds while you remain out of combat.

source.text:
4 Piece | From the Storm
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

After having maintained a state of not dealing or receiving damage for at least 9 seconds:
Grants a stack of Frost Armor every 3 seconds.
Stacks up to x5 Frost Armor, refreshing its duration every 3 seconds.
